extraction_notes: Figures 1 through 4 on p. 2 contain usable plotted rating and characteristic curves; points were manually digitized from the visible curves without interpolation and converted to SI units where applicable.
Figure 3 is the typical forward-voltage characteristic at Tj = 25 degC with 300 us pulse width and 1% duty cycle; the forward-current axis is logarithmic.

Figure 4 plots instantaneous reverse current against percent of rated peak reverse voltage and contains separate Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 125 degC curves; reverse current values were converted from microamperes to amperes.
For 1N4007W, the maximum repetitive peak reverse voltage and maximum DC blocking voltage are both 1000 V on p. 1; these ratings are not measured breakdown-voltage data.
The electrical characteristics table also publishes IR2 = 200 microampere at VR = VDC and Ta = 125 degC; the reverse_current field records the required 25 degC IR1 row.
No reverse-recovery time or measured breakdown-voltage/current characteristic is published in the supplied datasheet.
